title: Hosted machine approvals collected after expiry
text: The engine and CLI collect a code approved before expiry for ten minutes after it (approval at expiry minus 5 seconds, collected after expiry, is source-tested). On app.upyoke.com the Platform webapp poll still refuses an expired code before asking the engine, so a hosted approval landing just before expiry is still lost until PLAT-252 forwards expired codes to the engine. Owed: PLAT-252 and production proof of a late hosted approval connecting a Test Machine.
